decisions.subject: Street names that contain a building-type word
decisions.recommendation: Yes: a type word immediately followed by a street suffix (Ave./St./Rd./Blvd.) is not a named type. — Yes. Narrow namedTypes() in scripts/analysis/bylaw/clause.mjs:112. No keyed unit changes; 767 (C) then passes; no other agreed unit has a street name with a type word.
decisions.draft: Register: Spec 69a (new M row, G-CLAUSE arm any_with_named_type, extends M-76 A1). Row: "May the any_with_named_type check ignore a building-type word that is part of a street name (a word following 'On <number>' and preceding Ave./St./Rd./Blvd.)? Yes: narrow namedTypes() so a type word immediately followed by a street suffix is not a named type." Five words: standardized: one check rule; observable: gate reason code unchanged; scalable: covers all street names; accurate: PREVAILING on named lands is correctly "any"; understandable: one sentence; no scope creep: one regex in one function. Evidence: scripts/analysis/bylaw/clause.mjs:112-126 (namedTypes), :391-396 (the violation).
